turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
You entered a zero before anyone picked up a phone, Hale, and Owen found out on his phone in the middle of a class. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. On what basis?
I didn't come for thanks. Who decided on that zero, and did anyone hear from Owen before it went in?
Let me show you the version history. The document was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, and 1,406 words arrived in two pastes six minutes apart.

Turn the screen, Hale; I want to read it myself. I'm writing down 11:31 PM, 1,406 words, two pastes six minutes apart. Owen wrote it over the weekend, so where was he drafting before that document existed, and did anyone ask him before the zero went in?
Can you summarize what we've agreed so far in bullet points?
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. We haven't agreed anything: the zero comes off, and Owen gets heard before anyone decides anything about him.
Just a quick numbered list is fine.
No list. You still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in.
